header:
Awesome Productivity Tools

> Open-source notes, tasks, calendars, focus apps, launchers and personal knowledge tools. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Pick one system** for notes and one for tasks.
- **Use open formats** (Markdown, iCal) so you can leave.
- **Check the license.**
- **Back up.**

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
